# Vector V1: header profile (N42 mixed production standard, profile 1)

Generated by gov5 `internal/profile1_header_vectors_test.go` (TestProfile1HeaderVectorV1);
gov5's code is the bytes reference. Do not edit by hand: rerun the test with
`N42_UPDATE_PROFILE1_FIXTURE=1` (gov5 testdata copy) and `N42_PROFILE1_V1_OUT=<dir>`.

## Files

- `genesis_8s.json`: the profile-1 test genesis with the AM22 values (blockIntervalMs 8000,
  baseTimeoutMs 24000, maxTimeoutMs 96000, leaderTenure 1, epochLength 10800,
  gasLimit 480000000, deferredExecutionDepth 1), chain id 1144, four test validators.
- `header_profile_v1.json`: genesis header, two sealed headers, the validators (with their test
  BLS secret keys) and one refused header per rule.

Genesis hash: `0x188e9d930cfd43317416b0f65e8f98240ae686407ba806b854e98428c3b490dc`

## Contents of the JSON

- `genesis`: header fields, RLP and hash of the genesis (ommersHash zero, requestsHash
  EIP-7685's sha256 of nothing, element 22 the 0x80 gap, mobileRegistryRoot present and zero, extraData empty).
- `headers`: block 1 (view 1, no QC: nothing committed yet) and block 2 (view 2, the
  CommitQC of block 1 by validators 0, 1, 2). Each with its fields, RLP, hash, sealHash
  (keccak256 of the RLP with the last 96 extraData bytes removed, AM4), the seal (BLS,
  POP DST `BLS_SIG_BLS12381G2_XMD:SHA-256_SSWU_RO_POP_`), the signer (leader(v) = v mod 4) and, for block 2, the QC
  (SSZ as embedded in extraData; signed in the H2-v4 commit, changesHash zero (H2V4CommitSigningMessage)).
- `refusals`: each entry is block 2 with one rule broken (resealed by the leader unless the
  seal is the rule), the rule id, where it is checked (`import` = header verification on
  import, `vote` = only before the Round-1 vote with the given `nowUnix`,
  `execution` = the body reward list against withdrawalsRoot after execution), gov5's
  sentinel error and full message.

## Rules covered

B1 extraData layout `N42H || view u64 LE || [QC] || seal(96)`, at most 4096 bytes, an absent
QC is zero bytes; the QC is a commit-domain QC of the genesis set, below the header's view,
naming an ancestor. B2 seal by the leader of the view over sealHash. B3 difficulty, nonce,
mixHash, ommersHash zero (the empty-list hash is refused), coinbase = leader. B4
parent.time <= time (import) and time <= floor(now)+2 (vote time only). B6 withdrawalsRoot
present and equal to keccak(concat(rlp([address, amount]))) of the rewards. B8 requestsHash
present (its value is a deferred field, AM25; genesis and block 1 carry sha256("") =
0xe3b0c442...b855). B9 blobGasUsed = excessBlobGas = 0. B12 element 22 = 0x80.
B14 EIP-1559 baseFee from the parent header. A23 gasLimit = hotstuff.gasLimit.

Deferred fields (A10/B13: stateRoot, receiptsRoot, logsBloom, gasUsed; AM25: requestsHash) of
blocks 1 and 2 are genesis's (an idle chain); their checks belong to V5. parentBeaconRoot is zero on block 1
(B5) and Blake3 of block 1's committee evidence (the genesis committee pool) on block 2; the
evidence derivation itself is vector V2.

## AM24 (2026-11-24)

Republished from gov5 feat/profile1 at 96974101 (origin/main merged, AM24 merged).
AM24 replaces AM3: requestsHash on every profile-1 header, genesis included, is
EIP-7685's hash of no requests, sha256("") =
0xe3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855; the
empty-trie root 0x56e81f17...b421 is refused. Standard genesis hash:
0x188e9d930cfd43317416b0f65e8f98240ae686407ba806b854e98428c3b490dc
(was 0x6f733745...7e4f). V1 regenerated (header_profile_v1.json); genesis_8s.json unchanged (the JSON carries no requestsHash).

## AM25 (2026-11-24)

Republished from gov5 fix/profile1-requests-deferred at f8f15075 (on feat/profile1 df2763b5).
AM25 makes requestsHash a deferred field (header N carries block N-1's EIP-7685 requests hash;
genesis and block 1 carry sha256("")), so its value is no longer a header-only rule. The two
B8 value refusals ("requestsHash empty-trie root", "requestsHash empty-ommers hash", check
import) are replaced by one presence refusal "requestsHash absent" (check import,
ErrProfile1RequestsHash). The value refusals moved to V5 (check deferred). Genesis, blocks 1-2
and every other refusal are byte-identical; the genesis hash 0x188e9d93...90dc is unchanged.
